info.title: Pathfinder API
info.description: The analysis an investor would expect before committing years to a career: fit, pay, demand, AI exposure, confidence, a hedge career and a next step. Publishes its own track record.

get.description: Degrees, universities, skills, societies, competitions, alumni kit and a year-by-year plan.
Pay each year with its spread, nominal and in real terms (CPI-adjusted to the base year).
What an amount from one year is worth in another year's money.
Opportunities in your fields, with a digest. `today` is for testing; it defaults to the server date.
Hot specialisms, and the broader degrees that lead to them while keeping other doors open.

post.description: Stress test, hedge and confidence for one career, given your answers.

get.description: Ten careers as they looked in a past year, without the outcomes. Same year and seed, same ten.
The adviser view: every career at a glance, for one nation or region.
